0022600033.text: The San Antonio Spurs (6-2, on a six-game winning streak and 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-7, 15th in the West, coming off a loss) in their ninth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while the Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Daeqwon Plowden is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. San Antonio leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 130-103 win in San Antonio on October 27, and the Spurs also won all three meetings in 2025-26.
